name: Dwarven District
summary: Dwarven craftsmen keep their furnaces and workshops working in Stormwind's northern quarter. The district brings a piece of Khaz Modan to the human capital, with the Deeprun Tram linking it to Ironforge.

sections.title: A Home Away from Khaz Modan
sections.body: Dwarven artisans, smiths, and engineers make their home in Stormwind's northern quarter. Heavy stonework, smelting works, and craft shops recall Ironforge. At Potts' Plates, craftspeople from Khaz Modan find familiar company. On the district's eastern side, an open, arched tunnel leads to the Stormwind station of the Deeprun Tram, linking the human capital directly to Ironforge.

faq.q: Why is there a dwarven enclave in Stormwind?
aliases: why is it called dwarven district
faq.answer: The chronicles of this era do not record how the enclave began. Today, dwarven smiths, miners, and engineers fill its forges and workshops, while the Deeprun Tram links the quarter directly to Ironforge.

faq.q: How do you get to Ironforge from here?
faq.answer: On the district's eastern side, an open, arched tunnel leads directly to the Deeprun Tram station. The underground route carries travelers between Stormwind and Ironforge within minutes.

faq.q: What professions are trained in the Dwarven District?
faq.answer: The Dwarven District is Stormwind's premier hub for mining, blacksmithing, and engineering. Heavy forges, anvils, and dedicated trainers support all three crafts.

faq.q: Where can hunters train in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Stormwind's hunters make their headquarters at the Hunter's Guild in the Dwarven District, alongside dwarven marksmen and trade supplies.

angles.text: As a dwarf far from Khaz Modan, you can find familiar comfort in the roar of working blast furnaces and quick passage back to Ironforge.
As a blacksmith, you can use Stormwind's most capable smithing facilities, with expansive smelting forges, sturdy anvils, and veteran instructors.
